judgments.reason: The model never articulated a mechanism where the 3-coin commission is applied before payment to allow over-bidding; transcript and model_articulation describe the winner paying the bid then receiving a 3-coin commission, so no evidence supports the claimed precedence discrepancy.

The model did not claim or demonstrate that waiting exposes sealed rival bid values before committing; rules and observations state sealed rival bids remain private and the model's actions treat bids as sealed, so no mechanism of precommit revelation was articulated or shown.

The transcript shows settlement after all three lots were sold and the model explicitly states closing occurs when auction lots are resolved; there is no articulation or observation of early settlement with unsold lots, so the claimed discrepancy is not discovered.

The model did not assert or demonstrate that catalog purchases receive the 3-coin auction commission; the text distinguishes catalog buys as not auction wins and gives no mechanism substituting the commission onto catalog purchases.
